topography.project_purpose: Risk Curators. Structurally: 543 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 3 ERC4626 vaults, 66 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs, 1 ERC1155 multi-token, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 85 common project-authored base contract(s) (lptokenwrapper, irewarddistributionrecipient, basestrategy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
